destination.title: String/M-theory constructions, dual descriptions and consistency probes
destination.question: How do string/M-theory constructions realize field theories, spectra and defects, and which dual descriptions, limits and tests constrain them?
destination.summary: A proposed navigation family connects holography, little strings, heterotic sectors and microscopic limits. Clockwork and chiral-sector engineering provide adjacent directions. Shared methods do not establish common premises or fine question identity.

sources.title: Introduction to Gauge/Gravity Duality

evidence.text: How does gauge/gravity duality identify a quantum field theory with a gravitational/string theory, what is the working dictionary for AdS5×S5, and how can reduced-symmetry duals be generated?

sources.title: Bimetric, Conformal Supergravity and its Superstring Embedding

evidence.text: Can four-dimensional Einstein–Weyl supergravity coupled to super Yang–Mills be realized through massive open strings on D3-branes, and can its spin-two sector admit a holographic description involving spin-four bulk fields?

sources.title: Investigating 9d/8d non-supersymmetric branes and theories from supersymmetric heterotic strings

evidence.text: Which disconnected gauge components, nonsupersymmetric orbifold spectra, and associated branes follow from outer automorphisms of supersymmetric heterotic charge lattices in nine and eight dimensions?

sources.title: On non-supersymmetric heterotic branes

evidence.text: What charges, stability properties, and near-horizon worldsheet descriptions characterize non-supersymmetric heterotic 0-, 4-, 6-, and 7-branes, and how are their angular theories detected by Green–Schwarz couplings and related to topological modular forms?

sources.title: More on 8D nonsupersymmetric branes and heterotic strings

evidence.text: Which maximal gauge enhancements and corresponding massless spectra arise in the nonsupersymmetric E8 heterotic string on T², and what codimension-two branes in supersymmetric heterotic theories would their discrete symmetries imply under quantum-gravity conjectures?

sources.title: Non-supersymmetric branes and discrete topological terms

evidence.text: Can a proposed chiral spectrum for the non-supersymmetric heterotic NS5-brane reproduce the known spacetime Z3 topological term? Which lower-dimensional gravitational theories admit analogous terms through Green–Schwarz inflow?

sources.title: The Art of Networking: Networks of Trivalent 10d Heterotic Junctions

evidence.text: Which networks can be assembled from chiral trivalent junctions of the three non-tachyonic ten-dimensional heterotic theories, how can their topology be encoded and realized on the worldsheet, and what interpretations do higher-dimensional and compact networks admit?

sources.title: Heterotic little string theories and holography

evidence.text: Can linear-dilaton holography describe six-dimensional heterotic little string theories, reproduce their known chiral operators, and generate additional theories through modular invariants and orbifolds?

sources.title: Top Down Approach to 6D SCFTs

evidence.text: Why interpret a tensionless-string limit as a local CFT? The source cites tensor-branch theories, M5 near-horizon AdS/CFT, and bootstrap evidence as mutually supporting arguments.

sources.title: Chronology protection in string theory

evidence.text: Can string effects obstruct constructing the closed-timelike-curve region of over-rotating BMPV and Wave–D1–D5 geometries, while preserving unitarity in the dual conformal field theory?

sources.title: Introduction to Gauge/Gravity Duality

evidence.text: Radial quantization and the state-operator map organize spectra. Bulk propagator boundary limits and on-shell actions with suitable boundary terms generate correlators; double-line diagram topology organizes the large-N expansion.

sources.title: Top Down Approach to 6D SCFTs

evidence.text: Enumerate repeated marks summing to k, delete the selected nodes and read the commutant. Match SCFT boundary deformations within a fixed parent family, brane number and undeformed tail; otherwise the labels describe families.

sources.title: Bimetric, Conformal Supergravity and its Superstring Embedding

evidence.text: Assemble the scalar potential from conformal-supergravity matter couplings, eliminate D auxiliaries, and examine extrema using fermionic supersymmetry shifts. Propose spin-four boundary composites from Bach, Bel–Robinson and Weyl tensors.

sources.title: Investigating 9d/8d non-supersymmetric branes and theories from supersymmetric heterotic strings

evidence.text: Review and use root-lattice embeddings into even self-dual lattices through overlattices M, complementary lattices T, and discriminant-form gluing. The maximal-enhancement condition requires that the norm-two-generated sublattice of M equal the proposed root lattice.

sources.title: On non-supersymmetric heterotic branes

evidence.text: Construct rotationally symmetric gauge bundles using sphere tangent or spin bundles, then evaluate characteristic numbers with Chern roots and index-theorem arguments. Nonzero characteristic numbers obstruct smooth bordism fillings through a Stokes-type argument.

sources.title: More on 8D nonsupersymmetric branes and heterotic strings

evidence.text: Propose generalized Dynkin diagrams using charge-vector inner products. Choose a1=ω_k/κ_k, append an affine root to an ADE component, and use a second Wilson line from the shift algorithm before deleting another node. Charged long-root nodes depend on the selected E tensor.

sources.title: Heterotic ouroboros

evidence.text: Can the proposed circle-exchange quotient of M-theory on quantum S1 ∨ S1 acquire microscopic rules reproducing ten-dimensional nonsupersymmetric heterotic gauge groups and light spectra, and supporting heterotic junctions?

sources.title: Back to heterotic strings on ALE spaces. Part I. Instantons, 2-groups and T-duality

evidence.text: Determine heterotic E8×E8 ALE-instanton little string theories with arbitrary asymptotic flat connections, identify candidate Spin(32)/Z2 T-duals, and investigate the R-symmetry 2-group constant as an RG monotone.

sources.title: M theory as a matrix model: A conjecture

evidence.text: Can uncompactified eleven-dimensional M-theory in the infinite-momentum frame be defined exactly by the large-N limit of D0-brane matrix quantum mechanics, reproducing supergravitons, their interactions, membranes and the required spacetime symmetries?

sources.title: All eight- and nine-dimensional string vacua from junctions

evidence.text: Can string and 5-brane junctions, extended to O7+ planes, describe all known 8d theories with 16 supercharges, determine their global gauge groups and recover the 9d string-vacuum branches through decompactification limits?

sources.title: The Large $N$ limit of superconformal field theories and supergravity

evidence.text: Can decoupled brane field theories at large N contain supergravity excitations on near-horizon AdS compactifications, and can the corresponding full quantum string/M theories be defined through dual conformal field theories?

sources.title: Precision lattice test of the gauge/gravity duality at large-$N$

evidence.text: Can lattice D0-brane quantum mechanics, extrapolated to both the continuum and large N, reproduce the black 0-brane supergravity internal energy and constrain string corrections? The intended outcome is a quantitative test of the gauge/gravity conjecture, not a proof of the duality.

sources.title: QM2-branes and the Swampland Distance Conjecture in nine dimensions

evidence.text: Can all towers supporting the Convex Hull Distance Conjecture in nine-dimensional type II maximal supergravity be identified with sectors of supersymmetric M2-branes having discrete spectra?

sources.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Tensionless String Limits in 4d SCFTs

evidence.text: What microscopic string backgrounds explain the universality classes of overall weak-coupling, infinite-distance limits of large-N 4d superconformal gauge theories, including theories with non-Einstein holographic duals?

sources.title: The effective supergravity of Little String Theory

evidence.text: What minimal five-dimensional supersymmetric dilaton-gravity theory reproduces the linear-dilaton toy model of the holographic dual of Little String Theory, and what supersymmetry and four-dimensional spectrum does its background preserve?

sources.title: Branes and six-dimensional supersymmetric theories

evidence.text: How can brane configurations realize anomaly-free six-dimensional (0,1) theories, their proposed interacting strong-coupling fixed points, small-instanton transitions, and ultraviolet completions with gravity decoupled?

sources.title: Local SU(5) Unification from the Heterotic String

evidence.text: Can an anisotropic heterotic compactification produce a locally unified intermediate theory with consistent anomalies, three chiral families, and removable exotic matter? The further vacuum question is whether its singlet backgrounds and large dimensions can preserve supersymmetry and be stabilized.

sources.title: String Landscape and the Standard Model of Particle Physics

evidence.text: How do compactification geometry and discrete string data produce the Standard Model, determine its couplings, and constrain the string and supersymmetry-breaking scales?

sources.title: Heterotic String Compactifications on Half-flat Manifolds. II.

evidence.text: What gauge group, charged spectrum and matter couplings arise when the gauge sector is included in heterotic half-flat compactifications? Can geometric flux generate matter masses or spontaneous gauge breaking while satisfying the heterotic Bianchi identity?

sources.title: Reconciling Grand Unification with Strings by Anisotropic Compactifications

evidence.text: Can anisotropic heterotic compactifications reconcile gauge unification with the string–gravity coupling relation while permitting supersymmetric decoupling of exotics and acceptable proton decay?

sources.title: Heterotic mini-landscape. (II). Completing the search for MSSM vacua in a Z(6) orbifold

evidence.text: How many MSSM candidates arise when the Z6-II heterotic orbifold search includes the maximal three Wilson lines and arbitrary gauge shifts? How effective are local-GUT search criteria, and what hidden-sector condensation scales accompany the selected observable spectra?

sources.title: Moduli in General $SU(3)$-Structure Heterotic Compactifications

evidence.text: How do anomaly cancellation and α′ corrections constrain heterotic compactification moduli, which tangent-connection deformations represent physical fields, and can torsion or NS flux support geometric stabilization when four-dimensional maximal symmetry is relaxed?

sources.title: Effective Action from M-Theory on Twisted Connected Sum G$_{2}$-Manifolds

evidence.text: How does M-theory on twisted connected sum G2-manifolds determine a four-dimensional N=1 effective action, and how do building-block degenerations encode gauge enhancements and transitions between compactification geometries?

sources.title: Heterotic String Models on Smooth Calabi-Yau Threefolds

evidence.text: Can sums of line bundles provide a systematic supply of phenomenologically useful heterotic compactifications, and what controls their finiteness and deformation into non-Abelian bundles?

sources.title: Modular symmetries and the swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Which parts of an N=1 heterotic compactification retain enough supersymmetric structure to compute moduli-dependent gauge thresholds?

sources.title: String Phenomenology From a Worldsheet Perspective

evidence.text: Do higher-level, differently gauged or apparently non-(2,2)-based heterotic constructions belong to the same network of orbifolds and interpolations? These cases test the universal connectedness conjecture beyond the explicitly discussed SO(10) toroidal families.

sources.title: Special Geometry and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does the absence of world-sheet instanton corrections characterize compactifications protected by enhanced supersymmetry? The geometric questions distinguish absence of rational curves from cancellation of their contributions, with the Picard-number question forming the weaker target.

sources.title: Chern-Simons invariants and heterotic superpotentials

evidence.text: How can the gauge/tangent-bundle Chern-Simons contribution to heterotic vacuum superpotentials be computed explicitly, and when does it vanish or have fractional cycle coefficients?

sources.title: Generalized Vanishing Theorems for Yukawa Couplings in Heterotic Compactifications

evidence.text: Which geometric structures force perturbative heterotic superpotential Yukawa couplings to vanish, and how can ambient-bundle vanishing results be generalized algebraically to sheaf lifts and more general resolutions?

sources.title: Recent Developments in Line Bundle Cohomology and Applications to String Phenomenology

evidence.text: When can expensive line-bundle cohomology computations be replaced by closed topological expressions, what geometry explains their chamber structure, and how can these expressions support heterotic spectrum searches and complex-structure stabilization?

sources.title: Modular Flavor Symmetries and CP from the top down

evidence.text: How do heterotic orbifolds determine a unified flavor and CP symmetry, how is that symmetry spontaneously broken, and can an explicit string-derived model accommodate quark and lepton flavor data?

sources.title: Eight-dimensional non-geometric heterotic strings and enhanced gauge groups

evidence.text: How are eight-dimensional non-geometric heterotic theories with unbroken e8⊕e7 encoded by elliptic K3 geometry, and which points yield maximal non-Abelian gauge enhancement and a heterotic 5-brane interpretation?

sources.title: A heterotic Kähler gravity and the distance conjecture

evidence.text: Can integrating out complex-structure fluctuations of the heterotic superpotential produce a theory of residual hermitian and gauge fields with exponentially light towers at infinite complex-structure distance, and what cohomological structures govern its gauge symmetries?

sources.title: Compactifications of heterotic theory on nonKahler complex manifolds. 1.

evidence.text: Which compact complex non-Kähler manifolds support heterotic compactification with torsion and gauge flux, what are their geometry and topology, and can their flux superpotential stabilize moduli, especially the overall size?

sources.title: The String landscape, black holes and gravity as the weakest force

evidence.text: Does the heterotic mass-offset mechanism survive beyond toroidal compactification?

sources.title: Supersymmetric Standard Model from the Heterotic String (II)

evidence.text: Can heterotic compactification guided by local SO(10) unification produce the MSSM spectrum, decouple exotic matter consistently with supersymmetry, and accommodate realistic Yukawa couplings and hidden-sector supersymmetry breaking?

sources.title: Toroidal Orbifolds: Resolutions, Orientifolds and Applications in String Phenomenology

evidence.text: How can abelian toroidal orbifolds be resolved systematically into smooth Calabi–Yau threefolds and orientifold quotients, and how does this geometry support flux-induced soft supersymmetry breaking and assessment of KKLT candidate models?

sources.title: Merging Heterotic Orbifolds and K3 Compactifications with Line Bundles

evidence.text: How can six-dimensional heterotic Abelian orbifold vacua be matched to smooth K3 compactifications with line bundles, including apparent differences in non-Abelian groups, Abelian charges and massless spectra after blow-up?

sources.title: Duality anomaly cancellation, minimal string unification and the effective low-energy Lagrangian of 4-D strings

evidence.text: How do target-space duality anomaly cancellation and allowed matter modular weights constrain heterotic orbifold spectra, direct MSSM string unification, and supersymmetry-breaking soft masses?

sources.title: Compactifications of F theory on Calabi-Yau threefolds. 2.

evidence.text: How can elliptic Calabi–Yau geometry encode heterotic compactification and bundle data, determine six-dimensional spectra, and describe transitions between N=1 vacua?

sources.title: Anomalies, dualities, and topology of D = 6 N=1 superstring vacua

evidence.text: How do anomaly cancellation, global bundle topology and T-duality organize six-dimensional N=1 type I/heterotic K3 vacua, and connect the GP orientifolds to the symmetric E₈×E₈ heterotic models?

sources.title: Point - like instantons and the spin (32) / Z(2) heterotic string

evidence.text: Classify heterotic compactifications on K3 preserving the full primordial Spin(32)/Z2 perturbative gauge symmetry, and determine the nonperturbative physics when point-like instantons occupy orbifold singularities or coalesce.

sources.title: Astrophysical and cosmological implications of large volume string compactifications

evidence.text: Which microscopic cycle controls observable interactions, and how do matter wave functions depend on the compactification moduli? These assumptions determine whether canonical mass eigenstates couple at the string or Planck scale.

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Geometric Tools for String Compactifications

evidence.text: Which effective theories can arise from string compactification, and how can compactification geometries, gauge bundles and their simultaneous moduli be constructed, constrained and counted?

sources.title: Quasicrystalline string landscape

evidence.text: Which quasicrystalline Narain symmetries admit consistent lattice realizations, and what supersymmetric non-geometric orbifolds can they produce with few neutral moduli, exotic spectra, and large discrete gauge symmetries?

sources.title: A note on the holographic consistency of DGKT-type vacua with $h^{2,1}=0$

evidence.text: Do the extremal cubic-coupling cancellations found in the original DGKT orbifold persist in less symmetric compactifications with h^{2,1}=0, and what structure explains their persistence?

sources.title: Astrophysical and cosmological implications of large volume string compactifications

evidence.text: Insert canonically normalized couplings into two-body decay formulas, enforce the electron threshold, and distinguish partial from total lifetimes. For a heavy scalar, this calculation alone does not establish branching fractions for every open visible species.

sources.title: Local SU(5) Unification from the Heterotic String

evidence.text: Enumerate candidate states, impose sector-specific mass and phase conditions, intersect surviving gauge roots, and group states into supersymmetry multiplets. Equivalent fixed points supply multiplicities; inequivalent Wilson-line embeddings supply distinct charges.

sources.title: String Landscape and the Standard Model of Particle Physics

evidence.text: Compute the specified bundle indices, set the five Standard Model multiplicities to a common generation number, and impose vanishing indices for the displayed unwanted sectors.

sources.title: Heterotic String Compactifications on Half-flat Manifolds. II.

evidence.text: Contract each harmonic χ_a with conjugate Ω, multiply by 1/(2||Ω||²), and integrate the pairing of the resulting η representatives. Precise component placements require the original equation or earlier conventions.

sources.title: Reconciling Grand Unification with Strings by Anisotropic Compactifications

evidence.text: Analyze exotic mass matrices generated by singlet VEVs using superpotentials known through sixth order in MSSM singlets; solve Model 1A F-flatness conditions with superpotential coefficients set to one.

sources.title: Heterotic mini-landscape. (II). Completing the search for MSSM vacua in a Z(6) orbifold

evidence.text: Scan Wilson lines first for four SO(10)/E6 local-GUT shifts, then for arbitrary shifts. Filters select SU(3)×SU(2), three net (3,2), non-anomalous SU(5)-normalized hypercharge, three net SM families plus Higgses and vectorlike exotics, a heavy top, and decoupling of exotics through order eight.

sources.title: The fate of discrete torsion on resolved heterotic <math altimg="si1.svg"><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="double-struck">Z</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>×</mo><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="double-struck">Z</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> orbifolds using (0,2) GLSMs

evidence.text: What becomes of discrete torsion between orbifold twists after full resolution, when the smooth target space retains no corresponding discrete action? The paper uses GLSMs to track its manifestation in local and compact heterotic models.

sources.title: The physical moduli of heterotic G$_{2}$ string compactifications

evidence.text: How can infinitesimal physical moduli of heterotic G2 compactifications be described after eliminating independent tangent-bundle connection deformations, and can an associated metric, adjoint and cohomological formulation be supported by reduction to the SU(3) system?

sources.title: An SU(5) heterotic standard model

evidence.text: Can a stable heterotic compactification yield three Standard Model generations, exactly one conjugate Higgs doublet pair, and no exotic charged matter?

sources.title: A Heterotic Hermitian–Yang–Mills Equivalence

evidence.text: Can the supersymmetry equations and Bianchi identity for large-radius heterotic Minkowski vacua be reformulated as Hermitian–Yang–Mills conditions on an operator containing only physical deformation data, suggesting a heterotic analogue of Donaldson–Uhlenbeck–Yau?

sources.title: Gaugino Condensation and the Cosmological Constant

evidence.text: Can gaugino condensation, combined with H-flux, gauge bundles and perturbative higher-derivative corrections, generate a nonzero cosmological constant in a four-dimensional maximally symmetric heterotic compactification?

sources.title: Heterotic Moduli Stabilisation

evidence.text: Can weakly coupled heterotic compactifications stabilize geometric and gauge-bundle moduli with a phenomenologically suitable gauge coupling, while generating spontaneous supersymmetry breaking and approximately Minkowski or de Sitter vacua?

sources.title: Compactifications of heterotic strings on nonKahler complex manifolds. 2.

evidence.text: Can consistent heterotic compactifications with torsion be extended beyond previously studied zero-Euler-characteristic examples, while controlling anomaly cancellation, gauge bundles, chiral indices and higher-α′ effects through dualities and a complex-flux superpotential?

sources.title: Supersymmetric SU(5) GUT with stabilized moduli

evidence.text: Can the construction retain one light Higgs pair, remove dangerous color triplets, break SU(5), and generate realistic Yukawa couplings? The supplied pages identify absent up-type Yukawas as a defect and suggest geometric deformations without implementing them.

sources.title: Heterotic Line Bundle Standard Models

evidence.text: Can heterotic line-bundle GUT constructions be converted into explicit standard-model spectra, and what phenomenological restrictions follow from their additional U(1) charges?

sources.title: Moduli-dependent Calabi-Yau and SU(3)-structure metrics from Machine Learning

evidence.text: Can neural losses impose torsion relations used in heterotic supersymmetric compactification? The example targets geometric relations without constructing the remaining vacuum data.

sources.title: K3 surfaces and string duality

evidence.text: How do K3 geometry, world-sheet conformal field theory and string duality determine compactification moduli spaces, enhanced gauge symmetries and nonperturbative heterotic phenomena?

sources.title: Torsion in cohomology and dimensional reduction

evidence.text: Can torsion linking invariants, invisible to harmonic-form reduction, be recovered from smooth forms obtained by projecting calibrated-cycle currents onto the light massive sector of a supersymmetric compactification?

sources.title: The EFT stringy viewpoint on large distances

evidence.text: The toroidal heterotic model isolates shape limits with an explicit KK/winding spectrum. Universal and Kähler saxions can remain spectators.

sources.title: T duality can fail

evidence.text: Does torus T-duality survive nonperturbative string-coupling corrections in heterotic compactification on K3×T², and what geometric or supersymmetry conditions support a physically meaningful duality group?

sources.title: R-parity from string compactification

evidence.text: Can heterotic orbifold compactification supply a continuous R-symmetry direction whose discrete remnant suppresses proton decay while permitting a large top mass, an acceptable Higgs μ term and neutrino masses?

sources.title: Enhanced gauge symmetries and K3 surfaces

evidence.text: Do non-abelian enhancement points of type IIA on K3 coincide with conformal-field-theory orbifolds, or can identical singular target geometries describe different theories because of twisted B-field components?

sources.title: Symmetry enhancements in 7d heterotic strings

evidence.text: Which maximally enhanced gauge algebras and global gauge groups occur in the six treated components of seven-dimensional heterotic moduli space, and how do their lattice descriptions reproduce partial singularity freezing in dual M-theory on K3?

sources.title: Recent developments in heterotic compactifications

evidence.text: What replaces the A-model state space when heterotic left-movers couple to a holomorphic bundle E different from TX?

sources.title: Exploring the landscape of heterotic strings on $T^d$

evidence.text: Which ADE algebras are allowed in heterotic T² compactification before choosing explicit background fields?

sources.title: The Atiyah Class and Complex Structure Stabilization in Heterotic Calabi-Yau Compactifications

evidence.text: How can bundle holomorphy efficiently determine which complex-structure deformations remain supersymmetric, and provide hidden-sector bundles that stabilize many or all complex-structure moduli while accommodating a realistic visible sector?

sources.title: Strong coupling expansion of Calabi-Yau compactification

evidence.text: Can strongly coupled heterotic compactification preserve small four-dimensional gauge couplings and standard GUT relations while reducing Newton’s constant, and what limits the eleven-dimensional description?

sources.title: Massive U(1)s and heterotic five-branes on K3

evidence.text: How do bundle topology, gauge embedding and heterotic five-branes determine Abelian masses and generalized Green–Schwarz anomaly cancellation in six-dimensional heterotic K3 compactifications?

sources.title: Stabilizing All Geometric Moduli in Heterotic Calabi-Yau Vacua

evidence.text: Can gauge-bundle constraints, followed by gauge-invariant nonperturbative effects, stabilize the complex structure, Kähler moduli and dilaton of smooth heterotic Calabi–Yau vacua without NS three-form flux?

sources.title: Non-Abelian brane worlds: The Heterotic string story

evidence.text: Can SO(32) heterotic compactifications with stable unitary bundles and heterotic five-branes yield supersymmetric, chiral Standard-like or GUT-like models, extending the model-building possibilities related by duality to intersecting branes?

sources.title: String Phenomenology From a Worldsheet Perspective

evidence.text: Can the better-understood moduli and EFT descriptions of (2,2) heterotic vacua organize the much larger (2,0) class? The paper asks whether orbifold or interpolation connections provide a useful bridge.

sources.title: Supersymmetric Protection and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a four-dimensional N = 1 heterotic compactification have vanishing superpotential after strong gauge dynamics and all relevant instanton sectors are included? Appendix C tests whether gauge and worldsheet sectors alone can settle this question.

sources.title: K3 orientifolds

evidence.text: Which consistent Type IIB orientifolds at K3 orbifold limits extend the previously studied Z2 construction, and what do their spectra, local tadpoles and fivebrane dynamics imply for heterotic small-instanton interpretations?

sources.title: A Comprehensive Scan for Heterotic SU(5) GUT models

evidence.text: How large a set of phenomenologically promising heterotic SU(5) GUTs can be constructed by systematically scanning rank-five line-bundle sums, and does the number saturate as the integer search range increases?

sources.title: Infinite distance and zero gauge coupling in 5D supergravity

evidence.text: Does a vanishing gauge coupling coincide with infinite scalar distance in five-dimensional M-theory compactifications? The scalar space consists of fixed-volume Kähler deformations of a Calabi-Yau threefold, and weak coupling is detected by the full gauge kinetic matrix.

sources.title: A Heterotic standard model

evidence.text: Can smooth E8×E8 heterotic compactifications with SU(4) observable bundles and discrete Wilson lines yield three-family N=1 spectra without observable exotic matter, together with anomaly-compatible hidden sectors at weak and strong coupling?

sources.title: Exploring the landscape of heterotic strings on $T^d$

evidence.text: Which positive-definite enhancement root lattices of rank below d+16 admit the required embedding in the heterotic Narain lattice for a d-dimensional torus?

sources.title: Emergent strings, duality and weak coupling limits for two-form fields

evidence.text: Which Type IIA compactifications admit geometric weak-coupling limits for two-form fields? The source distinguishes their absence on K3 in six dimensions from two reduction sectors on Calabi-Yau three-folds in four dimensions.

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Remnants from the String Landscape

evidence.text: Which Standard Model matter additions occur in the three-node and four-node quiver sample summarized by Table 4, and which survive its exclusions? The available evidence consists of aggregate representation counts attributed to reference [44].

sources.title: Taming triangulation dependence of T$^{6}$/ℤ$_{2}$ × ℤ$_{2}$ resolutions

evidence.text: How can geometry, heterotic line-bundle consistency conditions and chiral spectra be computed for arbitrary local triangulations, and which conditions permit every triangulation simultaneously?

sources.title: Two Hundred Heterotic Standard Models on Smooth Calabi-Yau Threefolds

evidence.text: Can sums of Abelian line bundles on smooth Calabi–Yau threefolds systematically produce heterotic models with MSSM matter, and can their additional U(1) selection rules constrain phenomenology beyond the spectrum?

sources.title: Moduli-dependent Calabi-Yau and SU(3)-structure metrics from Machine Learning

evidence.text: How can compactification metrics be approximated across complex-structure moduli space, including geometries with torsion? Intended applications require metric information beyond massless spectra and holomorphic superpotential couplings.

sources.title: Exploring the landscape of heterotic strings on $T^d$

evidence.text: Which maximal-rank heterotic enhancements have explicit circle or two-torus backgrounds in the supplied tables?

sources.title: Emergent strings from infinite distance limits

evidence.text: Which mirror three-cycles realize D0 towers beyond maximal unipotent monodromy, and what realizes the accompanying heterotic string in Type K3 limits?

sources.title: Unification scale, proton decay, and manifolds of G(2) holonomy

evidence.text: What do calculable Kaluza–Klein threshold corrections imply for the relation between compactification volume, the inferred unification scale, Newton's constant and proton decay in M-theory models on singular G2-holonomy manifolds?

sources.title: State counting on fibered CY-3 folds and the non-Abelian Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can Calabi–Yau geometry reconstruct Heterotic supersymmetric indices and conjectural refined BPS counts, including higher-rank and CHL examples, and establish the non-Abelian sublattice weak gravity conjecture in these compactifications?

sources.title: A Mini-landscape of exact MSSM spectra in heterotic orbifolds

evidence.text: Can a targeted search using local SO(10) or E6 structures identify a substantial fraction of heterotic orbifold models with MSSM gauge symmetry, three families, standard hypercharge normalisation and decouplable exotics?

sources.title: The Exact MSSM spectrum from string theory

evidence.text: Can refining equivariant SU(4) bundles remove the extra Higgs pair and produce the minimal heterotic observable matter spectrum without exotic or additional vector-like fields?

sources.title: Exploring the landscape of heterotic strings on $T^d$

evidence.text: Which gauge enhancements occur in perturbative heterotic compactification on T^d, and which background fields realize them? The search concerns Narain lattice states in non-chiral theories with 16 supercharges.

sources.title: Chirality change in string theory

evidence.text: Can compactifications with different net chiral spectra be connected through smooth classical configurations describable by ordinary effective field theory, and can some connecting paths remain supersymmetric with no potential barrier?

sources.title: Exploring the landscape of heterotic strings on $T^d$

evidence.text: Which maximal-rank group labels and moduli are tabulated for two heterotic constructions on T²? Table 12 claims coverage of all allowed groups, whereas Table 13 gives selected examples. The supplied window contains only the final block of Table 12.

sources.title: Orientifolds of K3 and Calabi-Yau manifolds with intersecting D-branes

evidence.text: Can intersecting-brane orientifolds be extended beyond toroidal backgrounds to K3 and Calabi–Yau threefolds, with chiral spectra and consistency conditions determined geometrically rather than through explicit partition functions?

sources.title: Recent developments in heterotic compactifications

evidence.text: What infrared target appears when the eight quadratic fields become massive in the Landau-Ginzburg phase of the four-quadric GLSM?

sources.title: Emergent strings, duality and weak coupling limits for two-form fields

evidence.text: The attractive-K3 restriction makes one geometric tensor weak coupling limit accessible through Kähler intersections, without following the complex-structure-dependent tensor directions.

sources.title: New supersymmetric string compactifications

evidence.text: How can supersymmetric type II compactifications to four-dimensional Minkowski space be constructed on non-Calabi–Yau geometries, and how do NS/RR fluxes and geometric twists enter their supersymmetry constraints and effective superpotential? The paper also examines possible connections to smooth special-holonomy compactifications.

sources.title: Local SU(5) Unification from the Heterotic String

evidence.text: How do the local matter spectra and Abelian charge conventions enter the bulk and fixed-point anomaly tests of this heterotic model? The supplied window distinguishes bulk and local gauge factors but leaves the compactification geometry and full gauge embedding to earlier pages.

sources.title: Supersymmetric Protection and the Swampland

evidence.text: Must one-loop D-terms destabilize a chiral heterotic line-bundle locus by forcing U(1)-breaking singlet expectation values? The chosen two-E8 model saturates the Bianchi identity and initially avoids non-Abelian gauge superpotentials.

sources.title: Wilson lines and Chern-Simons flux in explicit heterotic Calabi-Yau compactifications

evidence.text: For an explicit heterotic Calabi-Yau compactification and specified discrete Wilson lines, can their Chern-Simons contribution to H-flux and the flux superpotential be computed, and does it threaten the assumed supersymmetric background or enable moduli stabilization?

sources.title: TASI Lectures on Remnants from the String Landscape

evidence.text: Which additional features recur in compactifications containing an observationally plausible perturbative visible sector, without requiring an exact prediction of every measured parameter?

sources.title: Gauge unification in highly anisotropic string compactifications

evidence.text: Can anisotropic heterotic compactifications reconcile MSSM gauge unification with the string and gravitational scales while preserving quantitative predictions, including when the string UV completion is strongly coupled?

sources.title: Supersymmetric Protection and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does identifying the gauge bundle with the Calabi–Yau tangent bundle protect the heterotic superpotential? This setting removes required spacetime-filling NS5 branes but retains strong gauge dynamics and possible vacuum-induced bundle deformations.

sources.title: Tensors from K3 orientifolds

evidence.text: Why do certain six-dimensional Type I K3 orientifolds contain extra tensor multiplets, unlike smooth-K3 compactifications, and what geometry and world-sheet consistency conditions explain the discrepancy?

sources.title: 'Anomalous' U(1) symmetry in orbifold string models

evidence.text: Which heterotic orbifold models contain an anomalous U(1), how can its generator be identified systematically with Wilson lines, and which discrete symmetries survive its breaking?

sources.title: Exploring the landscape of heterotic strings on $T^d$

evidence.text: Which ADE gauge enhancements occur in perturbative heterotic compactifications on T^d, which lattice obstructions exclude others, and how can one construct the corresponding background moduli up to duality?

sources.title: Constraints on discrete symmetries from anomaly cancellation in compactified superstring theories

evidence.text: Do discrete symmetries arising in heterotic compactifications satisfy anomaly constraints analogous to those for remnants of spontaneously broken gauge symmetries, thereby restricting the light effective theory?

sources.title: Exploring the landscape of heterotic strings on $T^d$

evidence.text: How do saturated orthogonal sectors of an enhanced Narain background determine each other's finite discriminant data?

sources.title: Stabilizing the Complex Structure in Heterotic Calabi-Yau Vacua

evidence.text: Can gauge-bundle holomorphy stabilize some or all complex-structure deformations in heterotic Calabi–Yau compactifications while preserving a supersymmetric Minkowski vacuum, and can this mechanism operate in a hidden sector compatible with realistic visible physics?

sources.title: Supersymmetric Protection and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a Bianchi-saturating heterotic candidate avoid both forced Abelian Higgsing and strong gauge superpotentials? The favorable quintic with two SU(3) monads provides a purely non-Abelian test with substantial chiral matter.

sources.title: Bundles over Nearly-Kahler Homogeneous Spaces in Heterotic String Theory

evidence.text: Can explicit gauge bundles on non-complex half-flat homogeneous spaces satisfy heterotic supersymmetry and anomaly constraints, and yield chiral four-dimensional models?

sources.title: Heterotic Flux Geometry from Chiral Gauge Dynamics

evidence.text: How can GLSMs be generalized to produce low-energy non-Kähler targets with H-flux, especially compact targets, and how do chiral gauge anomalies modify the resulting geometry?

destinations.title: Which microscopic cycle controls observable interactions, and how do matter wave functions depend on the compactification moduli? These assumptions determine whether canonical mass eigenstates couple at the string or Planck scale.

Can an anisotropic heterotic compactification produce a locally unified intermediate theory with consistent anomalies, three chiral families, and removable exotic matter? The further vacuum question is whether its singlet backgrounds and large dimensions can preserve supersymmetry and be stabilized.
How do compactification geometry and discrete string data produce the Standard Model, determine its couplings, and constrain the string and supersymmetry-breaking scales?

What gauge group, charged spectrum and matter couplings arise when the gauge sector is included in heterotic half-flat compactifications? Can geometric flux generate matter masses or spontaneous gauge breaking while satisfying the heterotic Bianchi identity?
Can anisotropic heterotic compactifications reconcile gauge unification with the string–gravity coupling relation while permitting supersymmetric decoupling of exotics and acceptable proton decay?

How many MSSM candidates arise when the Z6-II heterotic orbifold search includes the maximal three Wilson lines and arbitrary gauge shifts? How effective are local-GUT search criteria, and what hidden-sector condensation scales accompany the selected observable spectra?

How do anomaly cancellation and α′ corrections constrain heterotic compactification moduli, which tangent-connection deformations represent physical fields, and can torsion or NS flux support geometric stabilization when four-dimensional maximal symmetry is relaxed?

How does M-theory on twisted connected sum G2-manifolds determine a four-dimensional N=1 effective action, and how do building-block degenerations encode gauge enhancements and transitions between compactification geometries?
Which effective theories can arise from string compactification, and how can compactification geometries, gauge bundles and their simultaneous moduli be constructed, constrained and counted?
Can sums of line bundles provide a systematic supply of phenomenologically useful heterotic compactifications, and what controls their finiteness and deformation into non-Abelian bundles?
Which parts of an N=1 heterotic compactification retain enough supersymmetric structure to compute moduli-dependent gauge thresholds?

Do higher-level, differently gauged or apparently non-(2,2)-based heterotic constructions belong to the same network of orbifolds and interpolations? These cases test the universal connectedness conjecture beyond the explicitly discussed SO(10) toroidal families.

Does the absence of world-sheet instanton corrections characterize compactifications protected by enhanced supersymmetry? The geometric questions distinguish absence of rational curves from cancellation of their contributions, with the Picard-number question forming the weaker target.
How can the gauge/tangent-bundle Chern-Simons contribution to heterotic vacuum superpotentials be computed explicitly, and when does it vanish or have fractional cycle coefficients?

Which geometric structures force perturbative heterotic superpotential Yukawa couplings to vanish, and how can ambient-bundle vanishing results be generalized algebraically to sheaf lifts and more general resolutions?

When can expensive line-bundle cohomology computations be replaced by closed topological expressions, what geometry explains their chamber structure, and how can these expressions support heterotic spectrum searches and complex-structure stabilization?
How do heterotic orbifolds determine a unified flavor and CP symmetry, how is that symmetry spontaneously broken, and can an explicit string-derived model accommodate quark and lepton flavor data?

How are eight-dimensional non-geometric heterotic theories with unbroken e8⊕e7 encoded by elliptic K3 geometry, and which points yield maximal non-Abelian gauge enhancement and a heterotic 5-brane interpretation?

Which quasicrystalline Narain symmetries admit consistent lattice realizations, and what supersymmetric non-geometric orbifolds can they produce with few neutral moduli, exotic spectra, and large discrete gauge symmetries?

Can integrating out complex-structure fluctuations of the heterotic superpotential produce a theory of residual hermitian and gauge fields with exponentially light towers at infinite complex-structure distance, and what cohomological structures govern its gauge symmetries?
Do the extremal cubic-coupling cancellations found in the original DGKT orbifold persist in less symmetric compactifications with h^{2,1}=0, and what structure explains their persistence?

Which compact complex non-Kähler manifolds support heterotic compactification with torsion and gauge flux, what are their geometry and topology, and can their flux superpotential stabilize moduli, especially the overall size?
Does the heterotic mass-offset mechanism survive beyond toroidal compactification?

Can heterotic compactification guided by local SO(10) unification produce the MSSM spectrum, decouple exotic matter consistently with supersymmetry, and accommodate realistic Yukawa couplings and hidden-sector supersymmetry breaking?

How can abelian toroidal orbifolds be resolved systematically into smooth Calabi–Yau threefolds and orientifold quotients, and how does this geometry support flux-induced soft supersymmetry breaking and assessment of KKLT candidate models?

How can six-dimensional heterotic Abelian orbifold vacua be matched to smooth K3 compactifications with line bundles, including apparent differences in non-Abelian groups, Abelian charges and massless spectra after blow-up?
How do target-space duality anomaly cancellation and allowed matter modular weights constrain heterotic orbifold spectra, direct MSSM string unification, and supersymmetry-breaking soft masses?
What is the moduli dependence of one-loop gauge-coupling thresholds for all non-decomposable Z_N Coxeter orbifolds, and which target-space modular symmetries do their threshold functions exhibit?
How can elliptic Calabi–Yau geometry encode heterotic compactification and bundle data, determine six-dimensional spectra, and describe transitions between N=1 vacua?
How do anomaly cancellation, global bundle topology and T-duality organize six-dimensional N=1 type I/heterotic K3 vacua, and connect the GP orientifolds to the symmetric E₈×E₈ heterotic models?

Classify heterotic compactifications on K3 preserving the full primordial Spin(32)/Z2 perturbative gauge symmetry, and determine the nonperturbative physics when point-like instantons occupy orbifold singularities or coalesce.
